# Archdiocese of St. Louis

> > Official website of the Archdiocese of St. Louis, serving Catholic parishes, religious communities, and faithful across the St. Louis region with spiritual resources, administrative offices, and support services.

The Archdiocese of St. Louis provides comprehensive information about Catholic parishes, religious orders, vocational programs, and diocesan offices. The site serves as a central resource for sacramental records, crisis support, missionary formation, and administrative services for the Catholic community in Missouri.

## Key Topics

- Catholic parishes
- Archdiocese of St. Louis
- Parish boundaries and directories
- Vocational discernment
- Permanent Diaconate
- Religious orders and consecrated life
- Sacramental records and certificates
- RECA Program (Radiation Exposure Compensation Act)
- Missionary disciples
- Cathedral Basilica of St. Louis
- Kenrick-Glennon Seminary
- Spiritual crisis support
- Archival records and documentation
- Catholic community services
- Diocesan offices and agencies

## Parishes and Communities

- [St. Angela Merici Parish (Florissant)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/st-angela-merici-church-florissant): St. Angela Merici Parish in Florissant with contact info & mission
- [Annunciation (Webster Groves)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/annunciation-webster-groves): Annunciation Parish in Webster Groves with staff & boundary information
- [St. Clare (St. Clair)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/st-clare-st-clair): St. Clare Parish in St. Clair with clergy contacts & mission
- [St. Ignatius Loyola (Concord Hill)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/st-ignatius-loyola-concord-hill): St. Ignatius Loyola Parish in Concord Hill with contact details
- [St. Anselm (Creve Coeur)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/st-anselm-creve-coeur): St. Anselm Parish in Creve Coeur with clergy & boundary information
- [Sacred Heart (Elsberry)](https://www.archstl.org/parish/sacred-heart-elsberry): Sacred Heart Parish in Elsberry with contact & clergy information

## Diocesan Offices and Services

- [Permanent Diaconate](https://www.archstl.org/about/offices-and-agencies/permanent-diaconate): Permanent Diaconate Office: deacon formation, ordination & ministry
- [Information Technology](https://www.archstl.org/about/offices-and-agencies/information-technology): Office of IT services: network infrastructure, support & disaster recovery
- [Mission Office - Mass Requests](https://www.archstl.org/about/offices-and-agencies/mission-office/mass-requests): Mission Office Mass requests and offerings for priest support

## Support and Crisis Services

- [Spiritual Crisis Support](https://www.archstl.org/crisis-support/spiritual-crisis-support): Emergency spiritual counseling & crisis support services
- [Radiation Exposure Compensation Act (RECA) Program](https://www.archstl.org/radiation-exposure-compensation-act-reca-program): RECA program archival records & sacramental certificates for Missouri residents

## Vocations and Religious Life

- [Come & See Retreat](https://www.archstl.org/event/come-see-retreat): Come & See vocational discernment retreat at Kenrick-Glennon Seminary
- [Mass for the World Day of Prayer for Consecrated Life](https://www.archstl.org/event/mass-for-the-world-day-of-prayer-for-consecrated-life): Mass event for World Day of Prayer for Consecrated Life at Cathedral
- [Sisters of St. Joseph of Carondelet](https://www.archstl.org/religious_order/sisters-of-st-joseph-of-carondelet): Sisters of St. Joseph of Carondelet religious order history & contact
